name: ghostroute
displayName: GhostRoute — Free AI Router for OpenClaw
description: Run OpenClaw on OpenRouter’s free models with smart ranking, multi-fallback failover, and optional auto-rotation—so 429s don’t break your flow. Updates ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json safely (atomic writes) while preserving your existing setup.
author: Dr.Kittimasak Naijit

OPENROUTER_API_KEY.description: Your OpenRouter API key (get free at openrouter.ai/keys)

install: npx clawhub@latest install ghostroute && cd ~/.openclaw/workspace/skills/ghost-route && pip install -e .
